title: Clarity Week — runbook, exec intake & OKR drafts (v0.1)
body:
Purpose:
Compress cross-company planning into a focused "Clarity Week" to: align exec priorities, surface risk, finalize OKR drafts, and rehearse the all-company update. This doc is the runbook + intake for execs + working OKR drafts (v0.1).

High-level constraints (inputs):
- Timeline: 5 working days (Mon–Fri). Target all-hands on Fri 2pm PT.
- Output: final OKRs for leadership review, slide deck for all-hands, a short exec update memo, and a prioritized ask list for teams.
- Owners: Company Ops runs cadence; Product and Eng provide OKR lines; Finance provides FY impact estimates.

Agenda (detailed):
Day 0 (pre-work: Fri prior) — Packet out
- Send pre-reads: one-pager with current OKR deltas, metrics snapshot, and 3 solicitation questions to execs. (Owner: Ravi)
- Slack channel created: #clarity-week-2025 (Owner: Elena)

Day 1 — Reset + Strategy signal (Mon)
- 09:30 — Kickoff sync (30m): Exec signals (CEO + CTO) — what success looks like this quarter. (Owner: Marcus)
- 11:00 — Cross-functional intake (60m): Each area (Product, Eng, Sales, CS, Infra) lists top 3 asks + 1 measurable ask. Collate raw asks. (Owner: team leads)
- 14:00 — OKR rough alignment workshop (90m): put asks into objective buckets. (Owner: Ravi / Elena)

Day 2 — Reality check + capacity (Tue)
- 09:00 — Capacity review (Finance + SRE): available headcount runway, committed Dedicated contracts, infra spend delta. (Owner: Finance)
- 11:00 — Risk triage (45m): mapped to objectives (latency, cost, reliability, go-to-market). (Owner: Samir)
- Afternoon: Draft OKR 0.1 (product + eng owners)

Day 3 — Cross-company critiques (Wed)
- Morning: Silent critique pass — each team annotates OKR 0.1 doc (inline comments).
- 15:00 — Live review (60m): Exec panel challenges OKRs, looks for measurable KRs and dependencies. (Owner: Exec Admin)

Day 4 — Synthesis + comms (Thu)
- Morning: Final edits to OKR doc (v0.2) and exec memo drafted. (Owner: Product Ops)
- 13:00 — Deck rehearsal (all-hands run-through, 90m). Confirm run-of-show. (Owner: Communications)
- Evening: Send rehearsal notes and final pre-read to staff.

Day 5 — All-hands (Fri)
- 10:00 — Final prep for execs (speaker mic tests, backup slides).
- 14:00 — All-company sync (60–75m): Exec updates, 3 company OKRs, Q&A (live + Slack thread). (Owner: CEO + Head of Comms)
- 15:30 — Post-mortem (30m): capture feedback and immediate next actions.

OKR Drafts (v0.1) — Work-in-progress (short lines, owners, suggested KRs)
Objective A: Make inference predictable and cheaper for production apps (owner: Product/Serving Runtime)
- KR A1: Reduce median token cost for our top-10 enterprise workloads by 22% vs baseline (baseline: $0.0042/token).
- KR A2: P95 latency for hosted API (text-gen, 512 tokens) <= 280ms in 90% of requests.
- KR A3: Deploy 2 new model-variants (quantized 4-bit) across dedicated fleet with automated fallback.

Objective B: Enterprise adoption & reliability (owner: GTM/Customer Success)
- KR B1: 6 new Dedicated customers signed (monthly reserved spend >= $50k)
- KR B2: Time-to-onboard for Private deployments <= 21 days for 80% of customers.
- KR B3: Reduce support sev1 incident MTTR to < 45m (baseline 1h:20m).

Objective C: Developer velocity and observability (owner: Developer Experience)
- KR C1: SDK adoption: 30% of new API keys use the new SDK within 60 days of release.
- KR C2: Rollout success rate: 95% of canary rollouts complete without manual rollback.
- KR C3: Instrumentation coverage: 90% of customer-facing routes have token-level cost traces.

Exec update (one-paragraph sketch for all-hands lead):
- Theme: "Predictability over perfect" — short term moves to ensure customers can rely on latency/cost while we broaden model catalog.
- Quick wins: autoscaling policy changes deployed to two regions, new intelligent batching prototype reduced cost for a pilot workload by ~18%.
- Ask to staff: prioritize SRE/serving runtime capacity for Q2, freeze major non-critical infra migrations during sprint window.

All-hands run-of-show (Fri 14:00 PT)
- 0:00–02:00 (2m) — Welcome + housekeeping (Comms)
- 02:00–12:00 (10m) — CEO vision: where we are in market & 3 priority plays (CEO)
- 12:00–27:00 (15m) — CTO deep dive: Serving runtime wins and tradeoffs (CTO + Eng lead)
- 27:00–40:00 (13m) — Product highlight: Dedicated/Private milestones + customer story (Product + CS)
- 40:00–55:00 (15m) — Company OKRs (Ops)
- 55:00–70:00 (15m) — Live Q&A (Slack + mic)
- Post-call: link to recording + short survey in #clarity-week-2025

Runbook checklist (immediate TODOs):
- [ ] Finalize pre-read one-pager (Ravi) — due Fri prior 5pm PT.
- [ ] Confirm exec speakers and backups (Marcus) — due Mon 10am.
- [ ] Hook up telemetry dashboard for latency cost snapshot (SRE) — JIRA: ENG-5278.
- [ ] Build rehearsal deck with k/v caching demo clip (Product) — due Thu noon.
- [ ] Create post-allhands survey and automate results collate (Comms)

Metrics snapshot (to include in pre-read)
- MAU (product): 28,400 (MoM +4.3%)
- Top-10 workload median token cost: $0.0042/token
- Hosted API P95 latency (512 tokens): 320ms (current)
- Dedicated fleet utilization: 72% (target 65–80%)
- Net new Dedicated revenue (LTM): $1.1M
- Support NPS (recent survey): 62

Risk register (top 6)
- Risk 1: Dedicated capacity constraints if several enterprise rollouts overlap (mitigation: reserve burst pool + fallback model variants).
- Risk 2: Regression risk from aggressive quantization on fidelity (mitigation: automated evals and prompt-specific quality gates).
- Risk 3: Comms risk — mixed signals to customers if we change SLAs (mitigation: pre-announce with grace period).
- Risk 4: Hiring/people runway shorter than expected (mitigation: rebaseline Q2 hiring + prioritize top 3 hires).
- Risk 5: Platform incident during all-hands demo (mitigation: record demo + have video fallback).
- Risk 6: Conflicting OKR asks from Sales and Product (mitigation: ops mediates prioritization based on revenue impact).

Stakeholder intake template (for execs to fill quickly)
- Top 3 asks (1–2 sentence each)
- Expected impact (revenue, customer retention, cost)
- Required cross-team dependencies
- Suggested owner and timeline

Open questions (to resolve during Week)
- Q1: Do we accept a temporary increase in per-token cost to guarantee P95-250ms in one region? (trade: cost vs latency).
- Q2: Can Finance approve a $200k burst budget for Dedicated pilot? (Owner: Finance)
- Q3: Which feature toggles should be declared "no changes" during clarity-week sprint to avoid regressions? (Owner: Eng Leads)

Communication & follow-up
- Pre-read deadline: Fri prior 5pm PT.
- All-hands recording + slides posted to drive + confluence within 24h.
- Post-mortem + action list published in Confluence and triaged to Jira tickets within 48h.

Notes to self / working notes (messy, keep)
- Keep the all-hands to <75m — attention drops after 60 but execs need time.
- Might need two slides for the quantization story: one for cost, one for quality regressions.
- Pull a short customer quote for the Product segment (ask CS for two 30s clips).
- Consider a short live poll in the meeting to collect signal on the 3 proposed company objectives.

Appendix — quick links and references
- Current OKR doc (working): confluence:CLARITY-2025/okrs-draft-v0-1
- Latency dashboard: internal-grafana/teams/serving-runtime/latency-pt1
- Billing model analysis: drive/company/finance/billing-impact-q2.xlsx

-- end of runbook (v0.1)

Draft notes: this is intentionally concise—use as working doc. Expect multiple rounds. Mark comments inline and flag "must-resolve" items with the tag.
